summary.zh: 梳理 URL、导航与内链，修复结构性问题
summary.en: Fix URL, navigation and internal linking structure

description.zh: 分析站点地图和链接关系，找出孤立页面、层级过深和内链不足等结构问题，再给出 URL 与导航调整方案。适合 SEO 问题出在站点骨架、而非单页内容时使用。
description.en: Reads the sitemap and link graph to find orphan pages, deep hierarchies and weak internal linking, then proposes a URL and navigation structure. Use it when SEO problems are structural rather than page-level.
